nurse.text: Morning! King Edward Memorial Hospital sends its regards, and so does the Sanctuary. Sit your team on the counter, and I'll put the kettle on. Tea first, everything else after.
What can we do for you?

then.text: A cup of tea, a scone and a view of the harbour. The wind will sort the rest.
All better. They're tougher than a penguin in a gale.
The Ark's in the corner, next to the peat fire. It smells wonderful.
